state.description: Accounts can be either active or inactive.

hosted_login_token.description: The unique token for automatically logging the account in to the hosted management pages. You may automatically log the user into their hosted management pages by directing the user to: `https://{subdomain}.recurly.com/account/{hosted_login_token}`.

geo_code.description: Code that represents a geographic entity (location or object). Only returned when Vertex or Avalara for Communications is enabled.

shipping_addresses.description: The shipping addresses on the account.

has_live_subscription.description: Indicates if the account has a subscription that is either active, canceled, future, or paused.

has_active_subscription.description: Indicates if the account has an active subscription.

has_future_subscription.description: Indicates if the account has a future subscription.

has_canceled_subscription.description: Indicates if the account has a canceled subscription.

has_paused_subscription.description: Indicates if the account has a paused subscription.

has_past_due_invoice.description: Indicates if the account has a past due invoice.

updated_at.description: When the account was last changed.

deleted_at.description: If present, when the account was last marked inactive.

code.description: The unique identifier of the account. This cannot be changed once the account is created.

username.description: A secondary value for the account.

email.description: The email address used for communicating with this customer. The customer will also use this email address to log into your hosted account management pages. This value does not need to be unique.

override_business_entity_id.title: Override Business Entity ID
override_business_entity_id.description: Unique ID to identify the business entity assigned to the account. Available when the `Multiple Business Entities` feature is enabled.

preferred_locale.description: Used to determine the language and locale of emails sent on behalf of the merchant to the customer.

preferred_time_zone.description: The [IANA time zone name](https://docs.recurly.com/docs/email-time-zones-and-time-stamps#supported-api-iana-time-zone-names) used to determine the time zone of emails sent on behalf of the merchant to the customer.

cc_emails.description: Additional email address that should receive account correspondence. These should be separated only by commas. These CC emails will receive all emails that the `email` field also receives.

vat_number.description: The VAT number of the account (to avoid having the VAT applied). This is only used for manually collected invoices.

tax_exempt.description: The tax status of the account. `true` exempts tax on the account, `false` applies tax on the account.

exemption_certificate.description: The tax exemption certificate number for the account. If the merchant has an integration for the Vertex tax provider, this optional value will be sent in any tax calculation requests for the account.

external_account_code.description: Represents the account code for the external account.

external_connection_type.description: Represents the connection type. One of the connection types of your enabled App Connectors

external_accounts.description: The external accounts belonging to this account

parent_account_id.description: The UUID of the parent account associated with this account.

bill_to.description: An enumerable describing the billing behavior of the account, specifically whether the account is self-paying or will rely on the parent account to pay.

dunning_campaign_id.title: Dunning Campaign ID
dunning_campaign_id.description: Unique ID to identify a dunning campaign. Used to specify if a non-default dunning campaign should be assigned to this account. For sites without multiple dunning campaigns enabled, the default dunning campaign will always be used.

invoice_template_id.title: Invoice Template ID
invoice_template_id.description: Unique ID to identify an invoice template. Available when the site is on a Pro or Elite plan. Used to specify if a non-default invoice template will be used to generate invoices for the account. For sites without multiple invoice templates enabled, the default template will always be used.

geo_code.description: Code that represents a geographic entity (location or object). Only returned when Vertex or Avalara for Communications is enabled.
Code that represents a geographic entity (location or object). Only returned when Vertex or Avalara for Communications is enabled.

vat_number.description: Customer's VAT number (to avoid having the VAT applied). This is only used for automatically collected invoices.

card_type.description: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, JCB, etc.

first_six.description: Credit card number's first six digits.

last_four.description: Credit card number's last four digits. Will refer to bank account if payment method is ACH.

last_two.description: The IBAN bank account's last two digits.

gateway_token.description: A token used in place of a credit card in order to perform transactions.

cc_bin_country.description: The 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the card's issuer, if known.

funding_source.description: The funding source of the card, if known.

gateway_code.description: An identifier for a specific payment gateway.

account_reference.description: Used by Adyen and Braintree gateways. For Adyen the Shopper Reference value used when the external token was created. For Braintree the PayPal PayerID is populated in the response.

gateway_attributes.description: Gateway specific attributes associated with this PaymentMethod

card_network_preference.description: Represents the card network preference associated with the billing info for dual badged cards. Must be a supported card network.

billing_agreement_id.description: Billing Agreement identifier. Only present for Amazon or Paypal payment methods.

name_on_account.description: The name associated with the bank account.

account_type.description: The bank account type. Only present for ACH payment methods.

routing_number.description: The bank account's routing number. Only present for ACH payment methods.

routing_number_bank.description: The bank name of this routing number.

username.description: Username of the associated payment method. Currently only associated with Venmo.

primary_payment_method.description: The `primary_payment_method` field is used to indicate the primary billing info on the account. The first billing info created on an account will always become primary. This payment method will be used

backup_payment_method.description: The `backup_payment_method` field is used to indicate a billing info as a backup on the account that will be tried if the initial billing info used for an invoice is declined.

token.title: Token
token.description: Reference value used when the external token was created. If a Stripe gateway or Ebanx gateway is used, this value will need to be accompanied by its reference_type.

reference_type.title: Reference Type
reference_type.description: The type of reference token. Required if token is passed in for Stripe Gateway or Ebanx UPI.

items.title: Payment Gateway References Object
items.description: Array of Payment Gateway References, each a reference to a third-party gateway object of varying types.

payment_gateway_references.description: Array of Payment Gateway References, each a reference to a third-party gateway object of varying types.

created_at.description: When the billing information was created.

updated_at.description: When the billing information was last changed.

ip.description: Customer's IP address when updating their billing information.

country.description: Country, 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code matching the origin IP address, if known by Recurly.

name.title: Field name
name.description: Fields must be created in the UI before values can be assigned to them.

value.title: Field value
value.description: Any values that resemble a credit card number or security code (CVV/CVC) will be rejected.

source_record_type.title: Source record type
source_record_type.description: The type of record a custom field was automatically copied from.

source_record_id.title: Source record ID
source_record_id.description: The UUID of the record this custom field was automatically copied from. Only present when the field was copied from another record.

custom_fields.title: Custom fields
custom_fields.description: The custom fields will only be altered when they are included in a request. Sending an empty array will not remove any existing values. To remove a field send the name with a null or empty value.

entity_use_code.description: The Avalara AvaTax value that can be passed to identify the customer type for tax purposes. The range of values can be A - R (more info at Avalara). Value is case-sensitive.

bill_date.title: Bill Date
bill_date.description: The preferred billing date for the account. This date will be used as the billing date for when activating new subscriptions on the account.
